fixed_invariants: SAM2 checkpoint, parameters, memory writer, frame scheduler, dense current-frame queries, decoder, pointer tokens, and output decision remain native.
No ground-truth masks are read for this diagnostic.
Each shadow condition uses the same per-layer native Q/K/V; no earlier shadow result feeds a later layer.
The original Q/K/V tensors, pointers, bank payload, model parameters, and native decoder outputs must remain unchanged.
interpretation_limits: Six engineering targets are not representative cohort evidence.
Attention fidelity is not Dice improvement and can preserve native mistakes.
No tuning of scaling, matching or budgets is permitted.
The original calibration full-run assignment defect remains unresolved.
measurements: Per-frame/per-layer token counts, cluster mass, source frame IDs and temporal slots.
Spatial K/V norms before and mass-weighted after merging; pointer K/V norms separately.
Relative squared error, cosine similarity, and maximum absolute difference between each shadow attention output and the native attention output; zero-reference values explicitly null.
Nested calibrated_shadow distortion from same merged inputs and scale; both compared to native, with exact shared merged-input hashes.
name: Same-input calibration shadow applicability diagnostic
operation: For each native read and each of two ToMe conditions, compress once; compare ordinary and calibrated outputs against native; hash shared merged inputs; preserve original inputs, pointers, banks, weights, masks and presence.
purpose: Measure ordinary versus calibrated ToMe fidelity on exactly the same actual merged K/V. Return native outputs. No PiToMe condition or efficacy inference.
required_gates: Two fresh processes yield identical all-target measurement records and hashes
Native/no-op mask and presence equality; original bank/weights unchanged; four layers per target; exact shared merged inputs; pointers preserved
scope: Engineering/mechanism diagnosis only; not an efficacy experiment and not a full-video Dice result.
source_scope: All spatial memory frames selected by the unmodified SAM2 scheduler on the archived native history at each target; retain the original full-video length and native pointer timing.
stopping_rule: Stop interpretation on any parity, immutability, source hash, coverage or independent-process replay failure. If calibration fails to consistently improve attention fidelity, do not promote it to another efficacy run; even improved fidelity alone does not authorize efficacy.
